User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user within the LinkFlow application, primarily for linking learning resources.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

Tag.title: Tag
Tag.description: Represents a reusable tag used for categorizing learning links.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Tag entity.

name.description: The textual name of the tag (e.g., 'Programming', 'AI', 'Video').

LearningLink.title: LearningLink
LearningLink.description: Represents a single learning resource (e.g., article, video) managed by the LinkFlow application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the LearningLink entity.

title.description: The title of the learning link.

url.description: The URL of the learning resource.

description.description: A summary or description of the learning link, potentially AI-generated.

tagIds.description: References to Tag entities associated with this learning link. (Relationship: LearningLink N:N Tag)

isCompleted.description: Indicates whether the user has marked this learning link as completed.

color.description: The visual theme color chosen for the link card.

icon.description: The icon representing the type of learning resource (e.g., Book, Video, Globe).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the learning link was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the learning link was last updated.

userId.description: Reference to the User who owns this learning link. (Relationship: User 1:N LearningLink)

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique ID of the user.

definition.description: Stores learning links owned by the user.

firestore.reasoning: Standard LinkFlow structure using /admins/{userId} for role management.
